func CommitCasinoSeed(cur realm, roundId string, seedHash string) {
	if !isAdmin(cur) {
		panic("unauthorized")
	}
	casinoRounds.Set(roundId, `{"roundId":"`+roundId+`","seedHash":"`+seedHash+`","status":"committed","bets":[]}`)
}

func PlaceCasinoBet(cur realm, roundId string, game string, coinId string, betAmount string, choice string, clientSeed string) {
	requireNotPaused()
	caller := cur.Previous().Address().String()
	if isBlacklisted(caller) {
		panic("address banned")
	}
	amt, err := strconv.ParseUint(betAmount, 10, 64)
	if err != nil || amt == 0 {
		panic("invalid bet amount")
	}

	balKey := caller + ":" + coinId
	existing := uint64(0)
	if balances.Has(balKey) {
		existing, _ = strconv.ParseUint(balances.Get(balKey).(string), 10, 64)
	}
	if existing < amt {
		panic("insufficient balance")
	}
	balances.Set(balKey, strconv.FormatUint(existing-amt, 10))

	if !casinoRounds.Has(roundId) {
		panic("round not found")
	}
	bet := `{"addr":"` + caller + `","game":"` + game + `","coinId":"` + coinId + `","amount":` + betAmount + `,"choice":"` + choice + `","clientSeed":"` + clientSeed + `"}`
	casinoRounds.Set(roundId+":bet:"+caller, bet)
}

	if !isAdmin(cur) {
		panic("unauthorized")
	}
	casinoRounds.Set(roundId+":serverSeed", serverSeed)
	casinoRounds.Set(roundId+":status", "revealed")
}

func RefundCasinoBet(cur realm, roundId string) {
	requireNotPaused()
	caller := cur.Previous().Address().String()
	betKey := roundId + ":bet:" + caller
	if !casinoRounds.Has(betKey) {
		panic("no bet found for this round")
	}

	// Parse bet JSON to recover coinId and amount before removing the record.
	// Bet JSON format: {"addr":"...","game":"...","coinId":"...","amount":N,...}
	betJson := casinoRounds.Get(betKey).(string)

	// Extract coinId (quoted string value)
	coinId := ""
	coinIdStart := strings.Index(betJson, `"coinId":"`) + len(`"coinId":"`)
	if coinIdStart > len(`"coinId":"`) {
		coinIdEnd := strings.Index(betJson[coinIdStart:], `"`) + coinIdStart
		if coinIdEnd > coinIdStart {
			coinId = betJson[coinIdStart:coinIdEnd]
		}
	}

	// Extract amount (unquoted numeric value)
	amountStr := ""
	amountStart := strings.Index(betJson, `"amount":`) + len(`"amount":`)
	if amountStart > len(`"amount":`) {
		amountEnd := strings.IndexAny(betJson[amountStart:], `,}`) + amountStart
		if amountEnd > amountStart {
			amountStr = betJson[amountStart:amountEnd]
		}
	}

	amount, _ := strconv.ParseUint(amountStr, 10, 64)
	if amount > 0 && coinId != "" {
		// Restore the deducted balance
		balKey := caller + ":" + coinId
		current := uint64(0)
		if balances.Has(balKey) {
			current, _ = strconv.ParseUint(balances.Get(balKey).(string), 10, 64)
		}
		balances.Set(balKey, strconv.FormatUint(current+amount, 10))
	}

	casinoRounds.Remove(betKey)
}

// ── PvP Lobbies ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// CreatePvpLobby creates a new PvP lobby and escrows the creator's wager from balances.
// Phase 6: wager > 0 deducts from balances and records the escrow in pvpWagers.
func CreatePvpLobby(cur realm, game string, coinId string, betAmount string) string {
	requireNotPaused()
	caller := cur.Previous().Address().String()
	if isBlacklisted(caller) {
		panic("address banned")
	}

	wager, err := strconv.ParseUint(betAmount, 10, 64)
	if err != nil {
		panic("invalid bet amount")
	}

	// Escrow creator's wager from balances (if wager > 0)
	if wager > 0 {
		balKey := caller + ":" + coinId
		bal := uint64(0)
		if balances.Has(balKey) {
			bal, _ = strconv.ParseUint(balances.Get(balKey).(string), 10, 64)
		}
		if bal < wager {
			panic("insufficient balance for wager: need " + betAmount + " " + coinId)
		}
		balances.Set(balKey, strconv.FormatUint(bal-wager, 10))
	}

	prefix := caller
	if len(prefix) > 8 {
		prefix = caller[:8]
	}
	lobbyId := ufmt.Sprintf("pvp-%s-%d", prefix, time.Now().Unix())
	lobby := `{"lobbyId":"` + lobbyId + `","creator":"` + caller + `","game":"` + game + `","coinId":"` + coinId + `","betAmount":` + betAmount + `,"status":"open","round":1,"createdAt":` + strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().Unix(), 10) + `}`
	pvpLobbies.Set(lobbyId, lobby)

	// Record wager escrow (challenger is empty until JoinPvpLobby)
	if wager > 0 {
		pvpWagers.Set(lobbyId, coinId+":"+betAmount+":"+caller+":")
	}

	return lobbyId
}

// JoinPvpLobby joins an existing PvP lobby and escrows the challenger's matching wager.
// Phase 6: deducts challenger's matching wager from balances and updates pvpWagers.
func JoinPvpLobby(cur realm, lobbyId string) {
	requireNotPaused()
	caller := cur.Previous().Address().String()
	if isBlacklisted(caller) {
		panic("address banned")
	}

	if !pvpLobbies.Has(lobbyId) {
		panic("lobby not found")
	}
	if pvpLobbies.Has(lobbyId + ":challenger") {
		panic("lobby already full")
	}

	// Parse coinId and betAmount from wager record
	if pvpWagers.Has(lobbyId) {
		wagerStr := pvpWagers.Get(lobbyId).(string)
		parts := strings.SplitN(wagerStr, ":", 4)
		if len(parts) == 4 {
			coinId := parts[0]
			betAmountStr := parts[1]
			creator := parts[2]

			if caller == creator {
				panic("cannot join your own lobby")
			}

			wager, _ := strconv.ParseUint(betAmountStr, 10, 64)
			if wager > 0 {
				// Escrow challenger's matching wager
				balKey := caller + ":" + coinId
				bal := uint64(0)
				if balances.Has(balKey) {
					bal, _ = strconv.ParseUint(balances.Get(balKey).(string), 10, 64)
				}
				if bal < wager {
					panic("insufficient balance for wager: need " + betAmountStr + " " + coinId)
				}
				balances.Set(balKey, strconv.FormatUint(bal-wager, 10))
				// Update wager record with challenger address
				pvpWagers.Set(lobbyId, coinId+":"+betAmountStr+":"+creator+":"+caller)
			}
		}
	}

	pvpLobbies.Set(lobbyId+":challenger", caller)
	pvpLobbies.Set(lobbyId+":status", "joined")
}

func CommitPvpMove(cur realm, lobbyId string, moveHash string) {

// RevealPvpMove requires both players to have committed before either can reveal.
// Phase 6: when both players have revealed, determines the RPS winner and pays out
// 2× wager minus 2% rake to the winner. Draw = full refund to both players.
// pvpWagers.Remove is called after payout to prevent double-payouts.
func RevealPvpMove(cur realm, lobbyId string, choice string, salt string) {
	requireNotPaused()
	caller := cur.Previous().Address().String()

	// Verify lobby exists and both players have committed
	if !pvpLobbies.Has(lobbyId) {
		panic("lobby not found")
	}
	lobbyJson := pvpLobbies.Get(lobbyId).(string)
	// Extract creator address from JSON
	creatorStart := strings.Index(lobbyJson, `"creator":"`) + len(`"creator":"`)
	creatorEnd := strings.Index(lobbyJson[creatorStart:], `"`) + creatorStart
	creator := lobbyJson[creatorStart:creatorEnd]

	// Require challenger has joined
	if !pvpLobbies.Has(lobbyId + ":challenger") {
		panic("no opponent has joined yet")
	}
	challenger := pvpLobbies.Get(lobbyId + ":challenger").(string)

	// Require both commits are present
	if !pvpLobbies.Has(lobbyId+":commit:"+creator) || !pvpLobbies.Has(lobbyId+":commit:"+challenger) {
		panic("both players must commit moves before revealing")
	}

	pvpLobbies.Set(lobbyId+":reveal:"+caller, choice+":"+salt)

	// Check if both players have now revealed
	creatorRevealed := pvpLobbies.Has(lobbyId + ":reveal:" + creator)
	challengerRevealed := pvpLobbies.Has(lobbyId + ":reveal:" + challenger)

	if creatorRevealed && challengerRevealed {
		// Both revealed — determine winner and pay out
		creatorReveal := pvpLobbies.Get(lobbyId + ":reveal:" + creator).(string)
		challengerReveal := pvpLobbies.Get(lobbyId + ":reveal:" + challenger).(string)

		creatorChoice := strings.SplitN(creatorReveal, ":", 2)[0]
		challengerChoice := strings.SplitN(challengerReveal, ":", 2)[0]

		winner := ""
		// Rock-Paper-Scissors logic: rock beats scissors, scissors beats paper, paper beats rock
		if creatorChoice == challengerChoice {
			winner = "draw"
		} else if (creatorChoice == "rock" && challengerChoice == "scissors") ||
			(creatorChoice == "scissors" && challengerChoice == "paper") ||
			(creatorChoice == "paper" && challengerChoice == "rock") {
			winner = creator
		} else {
			winner = challenger
		}

		pvpLobbies.Set(lobbyId+":winner", winner)
		pvpLobbies.Set(lobbyId+":status", "finished")

		// Pay out wager to winner (or refund both on draw)
		if pvpWagers.Has(lobbyId) {
			wagerStr := pvpWagers.Get(lobbyId).(string)
			parts := strings.SplitN(wagerStr, ":", 4)
			if len(parts) == 4 {
				coinId := parts[0]
				wager, _ := strconv.ParseUint(parts[1], 10, 64)

				if wager > 0 {
					rake := wager * 2 / 100  // 2% rake to admin
					payout := (wager * 2) - rake

					if winner == "draw" {
						// Refund both players their wager
						for _, addr := range []string{creator, challenger} {
							balKey := addr + ":" + coinId
							bal := uint64(0)
							if balances.Has(balKey) {
								bal, _ = strconv.ParseUint(balances.Get(balKey).(string), 10, 64)
							}
							balances.Set(balKey, strconv.FormatUint(bal+wager, 10))
						}
					} else {
						// Pay winner 2× wager minus 2% rake
						winKey := winner + ":" + coinId
						winBal := uint64(0)
						if balances.Has(winKey) {
							winBal, _ = strconv.ParseUint(balances.Get(winKey).(string), 10, 64)
						}
						balances.Set(winKey, strconv.FormatUint(winBal+payout, 10))

						// Rake goes to admin
						adminKey := admin.String() + ":" + coinId
						adminBal := uint64(0)
						if balances.Has(adminKey) {
							adminBal, _ = strconv.ParseUint(balances.Get(adminKey).(string), 10, 64)
						}
						balances.Set(adminKey, strconv.FormatUint(adminBal+rake, 10))
					}

					// Remove wager record after payout to prevent double-payouts
					pvpWagers.Remove(lobbyId)
				}
			}
		}
	} else {
		pvpLobbies.Set(lobbyId+":status", "revealed")
	}
}

// ClaimPvpTimeout allows a lobby participant to claim a timeout win.
// Only the creator or challenger may call this.
// Phase 6: refunds the escrowed wager to all parties who contributed.
func ClaimPvpTimeout(cur realm, lobbyId string) {
	requireNotPaused()
	caller := cur.Previous().Address().String()

	if !pvpLobbies.Has(lobbyId) {
		panic("lobby not found")
	}
	lobbyJson := pvpLobbies.Get(lobbyId).(string)

	// Extract creator address
	creatorStart := strings.Index(lobbyJson, `"creator":"`) + len(`"creator":"`)
	creatorEnd := strings.Index(lobbyJson[creatorStart:], `"`) + creatorStart
	creator := lobbyJson[creatorStart:creatorEnd]

	// Get challenger (may not exist yet)
	challenger := ""
	if pvpLobbies.Has(lobbyId + ":challenger") {
		challenger = pvpLobbies.Get(lobbyId + ":challenger").(string)
	}

	// Verify caller is a participant
	if caller != creator && caller != challenger {
		panic("not a lobby participant")
	}

	// Require minimum 10 minutes since lobby creation
	createdAtStart := strings.Index(lobbyJson, `"createdAt":`) + len(`"createdAt":`)
	createdAtEnd := strings.IndexAny(lobbyJson[createdAtStart:], `,}`) + createdAtStart
	createdAt, _ := strconv.ParseInt(lobbyJson[createdAtStart:createdAtEnd], 10, 64)
	if time.Now().Unix()-createdAt < 600 {
		panic("timeout not yet claimable — minimum 10 minutes must elapse")
	}

	pvpLobbies.Set(lobbyId+":winner", caller)
	pvpLobbies.Set(lobbyId+":status", "finished")

	// Phase 6: Refund escrowed wagers.
	// On timeout the creator always escrowed; the challenger may or may not have joined.
	// Refund both if they both escrowed (challenger joined but neither revealed in time).
	// If only the creator escrowed (challenger never joined), refund only the creator.
	if pvpWagers.Has(lobbyId) {
		wagerStr := pvpWagers.Get(lobbyId).(string)
		parts := strings.SplitN(wagerStr, ":", 4)
		if len(parts) == 4 {
			coinId := parts[0]
			wager, _ := strconv.ParseUint(parts[1], 10, 64)
			creatorInWager := parts[2]
			challengerInWager := parts[3]
			// Refund whoever escrowed (creator always did; challenger may have joined)
			if wager > 0 {
				for _, addr := range []string{creatorInWager, challengerInWager} {
					if addr == "" {
						continue
					}
					balKey := addr + ":" + coinId
					bal := uint64(0)
					if balances.Has(balKey) {
						bal, _ = strconv.ParseUint(balances.Get(balKey).(string), 10, 64)
					}
					balances.Set(balKey, strconv.FormatUint(bal+wager, 10))
				}
				pvpWagers.Remove(lobbyId)
			}
		}
	}
}

// ── Coin Transfer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Transfer sends coinId coins from the caller to toAddr directly on-chain.
// Both addresses must have interacted with the game realm at least once.
func Transfer(cur realm, coinId string, toAddr string, amountStr string) {
	requireNotPaused()
	caller := cur.Previous().Address().String()
	if isBlacklisted(caller) {
		panic("address banned")
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(toAddr, "g1") {
		panic("invalid destination address")
	}
	if caller == toAddr {
		panic("cannot transfer to yourself")
	}
	amount, err := strconv.ParseUint(amountStr, 10, 64)
	if err != nil || amount == 0 {
		panic("invalid amount")
	}

	fromKey := caller + ":" + coinId
	have := uint64(0)
	if balances.Has(fromKey) {
		have, _ = strconv.ParseUint(balances.Get(fromKey).(string), 10, 64)
	}
	if have < amount {
		panic("insufficient balance: need " + amountStr + " have " + strconv.FormatUint(have, 10))
	}

	// Deduct from sender
	balances.Set(fromKey, strconv.FormatUint(have-amount, 10))

	// Credit recipient
	toKey := toAddr + ":" + coinId
	toHave := uint64(0)
	if balances.Has(toKey) {
		toHave, _ = strconv.ParseUint(balances.Get(toKey).(string), 10, 64)
	}
	balances.Set(toKey, strconv.FormatUint(toHave+amount, 10))
}

func BuyTool(cur realm, toolId string) {
	requireNotPaused()
	caller := cur.Previous().Address().String()
	if isBlacklisted(caller) {
		panic("address banned")
	}

	// Look up cost
	costs, hasCost := toolCosts[toolId]
	if !hasCost && toolId != "hands" {
		panic("unknown tool: " + toolId)
	}

	// Deduct balance (hands is free, others require coins)
	if hasCost && len(costs) > 0 {
		deductBalances(caller, costs)
	}

	// Grant tool
	existing := ""
	if ownedTools.Has(caller) {
		existing = ownedTools.Get(caller).(string)
	}
	if existing == "" {
		ownedTools.Set(caller, toolId)
	} else {
		ownedTools.Set(caller, existing+","+toolId)
	}
}

func RepairTool(cur realm, toolId string) {
	requireNotPaused()
	caller := cur.Previous().Address().String()
	if isBlacklisted(caller) {
		panic("address banned")
	}

	maxLife, hasLife := toolMaxLife[toolId]
	if !hasLife || maxLife == 0 {
		panic("tool cannot be repaired: " + toolId)
	}

	// Cost = 30% of craft cost (rounded up per coin)
	baseCosts, hasCost := toolCosts[toolId]
	if !hasCost {
		panic("unknown tool: " + toolId)
	}
	var repairCosts [][2]string
	for _, pair := range baseCosts {
		coinId, amtStr := pair[0], pair[1]
		baseAmt, _ := strconv.ParseUint(amtStr, 10, 64)
		// 30% rounded up: (base * 30 + 99) / 100
		repairAmt := (baseAmt*30 + 99) / 100
		if repairAmt > 0 {
			repairCosts = append(repairCosts, [2]string{coinId, strconv.FormatUint(repairAmt, 10)})
		}
	}

	deductBalances(caller, repairCosts)

	// Restore full durability
	toolLife.Set(caller+":"+toolId, strconv.FormatUint(maxLife, 10))
}

// ── Progression ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func TrainSkill(cur realm, skillId string) {
	requireNotPaused()
	caller := cur.Previous().Address().String()
	if isBlacklisted(caller) {
		panic("address banned")
	}
	key := caller + ":" + skillId

	// Look up current rank
	rank := uint64(0)
	if skillRanks.Has(key) {
		rank, _ = strconv.ParseUint(skillRanks.Get(key).(string), 10, 64)
	}

	// Check rank cap
	maxRank, hasMax := skillMaxRanks[skillId]
	if !hasMax {
		panic("unknown skill: " + skillId)
	}
	if rank >= maxRank {
		panic("skill already at maximum rank")
	}

	// Compute cost: base × 2^rank
	baseCosts, hasCost := skillBaseCosts[skillId]
	if !hasCost {
		panic("unknown skill: " + skillId)
	}
	var scaledCosts [][2]string
	multiplier := uint64(1)
	for i := uint64(0); i < rank; i++ {
		multiplier *= 2
	}
	for _, pair := range baseCosts {
		coinId, amtStr := pair[0], pair[1]
		baseAmt, _ := strconv.ParseUint(amtStr, 10, 64)
		scaled := baseAmt * multiplier
		if scaled > 0 {
			scaledCosts = append(scaledCosts, [2]string{coinId, strconv.FormatUint(scaled, 10)})
		}
	}

	deductBalances(caller, scaledCosts)

	// Increment rank
	skillRanks.Set(key, strconv.FormatUint(rank+1, 10))
}

// ── Render ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

func Render(_ string) string {
	return ufmt.Sprintf("# GnoMoji Game Realm\n\nAdmin: `%s`\n\nPath: `gno.land/r/g138gdmwj6heduu3st796lw6qqdwylgaxf7ty5gz/game11`\n\nMine emoji coins on Gno.land!\n", admin.String())
}

// ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// deductBalances atomically checks all balances then deducts them.
// Panics if any balance is insufficient — no partial deductions.
// costs is a slice of [coinId, amount] pairs.
func deductBalances(caller string, costs [][2]string) {
	// First pass: verify all sufficient
	for _, pair := range costs {
		coinId, amtStr := pair[0], pair[1]
		required, err := strconv.ParseUint(amtStr, 10, 64)
		if err != nil || required == 0 {
			continue
		}
		balKey := caller + ":" + coinId
		have := uint64(0)
		if balances.Has(balKey) {
			have, _ = strconv.ParseUint(balances.Get(balKey).(string), 10, 64)
		}
		if have < required {
			panic("insufficient " + coinId + ": need " + amtStr + " have " + strconv.FormatUint(have, 10))
		}
	}
	// Second pass: deduct all
	for _, pair := range costs {
		coinId, amtStr := pair[0], pair[1]
		required, err := strconv.ParseUint(amtStr, 10, 64)
		if err != nil || required == 0 {
			continue
		}
		balKey := caller + ":" + coinId
		current, _ := strconv.ParseUint(balances.Get(balKey).(string), 10, 64)
		balances.Set(balKey, strconv.FormatUint(current-required, 10))
	}
}

func splitJsonArray(s string) []string {
	var result []string
	depth, start := 0, 0
	for i := 0; i < len(s); i++ {
		switch s[i] {
		case '[', '{':
			depth++
		case ']', '}':
			depth--
		case ',':
			if depth == 0 {
				if e := strings.TrimSpace(s[start:i]); e != "" {
					result = append(result, e)
				}
				start = i + 1
			}
		}
	}
	if e := strings.TrimSpace(s[start:]); e != "" {
		result = append(result, e)
	}
	return result
}

files.body:
# `connect4` - staked Connect 4

## Context

We want a real-money Connect 4 on gno.land: equal ugnot stakes, winner takes
the pot minus a small house fee, fast turns, a lobby of offers open for the
next N minutes, and a guarantee both players are present once a game starts.

Two platform facts shape the design:

- `time.Now()` is the block timestamp. It is deterministic and only advances
  per block; nothing executes on its own, so deadlines are enforced lazily by
  whichever transaction checks them.
- Presence cannot be observed on-chain. The only proof a player is there is a
  transaction they signed.

## Decision

- **Lobby of offers.** `Offer` escrows the creator's stake with an expiry
  (1-60 min) and an optional reserved opponent. `Accept` must send exactly the
  same stake. Both use `cur.Previous().IsUserCall()` + `unsafe.OriginSend()`.
- **Presence via the move clock.** Each move has 90s of block time. `Accept`
  proves the acceptor is present, `Reveal` the creator, and the first move
  the first mover. If
  the clock runs out with zero moves the game is void and both stakes are
  refunded (the absent player may be the creator who posted long ago); after
  at least one move, the player on turn forfeits. Anyone can call
  `ClaimTimeout`, so bystanders can settle stuck games. A late `Play` panics
  rather than settling, keeping one settlement path.
- **First mover by two-sided commit-reveal.** `Offer` takes `commitment`,
  the lowercase hex `sha256(passphrase)`; `Accept` takes `seedCommitment`,
  the same for the acceptor's seed. The game then waits (`Turn = 0`, `Play`
  rejected) for the creator's `Reveal(id, passphrase)` within 90s of Accept,
  then the acceptor's `RevealSeed(id, seed)` within 90s of that. The first
  mover is the low bit of `sha256(passphrase|seed|id|creator|acceptor)`.
  When a player commits, the other side's secret is still hidden, so neither
  can grind for an outcome; once revealed, a secret can't change. The only
  way out is not revealing, which forfeits: `ClaimTimeout` pays the other
  player as a win. A pending Accept shows only a hash, so a creator watching
  the mempool learns nothing it could cancel on.
- **Commitments are one-use per address.** A revealed secret is public, so
  reusing it would let the other side compute the draw. Reuse is refused per
  address (creator or acceptor), never globally, so nobody can block another
  player's offer by posting its commitment first.
- **Fee** is a flat 0.1 GNOT (100,000 ugnot) per decisive game (one with a
  winner), adjustable by the owner up to 0.5 GNOT (half the minimum stake)
  and snapshotted per game at `Offer`, so a live game's terms never change.
  `Offer` takes the highest fee the creator accepts (`maxFee`) and refuses a
  higher one, so the owner can't raise it while an offer is in flight; the
  cap bounds it for everyone. `ActiveJSON` gives the current fee, and the
  gnoweb offer link passes it. Draws and void games pay no fee. The lobby shows each offer's
  own fee. The owner (`p/nt/ownable/v0`) can `SetFee` and `WithdrawFees`
  (collected fees only, never stakes); it is whoever deploys the realm
  (`init` with an `IsUserCall()` previous), so the deploying multisig owns it
  with no address baked into the code. Ownership moves in two steps,
  `TransferOwnership(newOwner)` then `AcceptOwnership()` by that address, so
  a mistyped spelling can never strand ownership and fees.
- **Address arguments must be canonical.** The chain accepts four texts for
  one address (bech32 or bech32m, lower or upper case), but a caller's
  address is always lower-case bech32. An opponent or a new owner in another
  spelling could never match its caller, so `Offer` and `TransferOwnership`
  refuse it (`address.gno`, the check of `p/samcrew/launchpad/meta/v1`,
  copied so the realm doesn't depend on that package).
- **Stale moves.** `Play(id, column, move)` takes the move count the player
  saw and refuses any other. A client that re-sends a move whose outcome it
  could not see (a dropped response) cannot have it land on a later turn.
- **Session keys.** Calls signed by a tm2 account session key (gno #5307;
  `runtime.GetSessionInfo`) may `Play`, `Reveal`, `RevealSeed`,
  `ClaimTimeout` and `Cancel` only. Session allow-paths are per realm, not per function, and a
  session's spend limit counts gas and sent coins but not what a call
  forfeits: a stolen session key could otherwise `Resign` every live game.
  `Offer`/`Accept` (stakes) and the owner functions need the account's own
  key too.
- **Cancel.** The creator may cancel an open offer at any time; anyone may
  once it has expired, so stale offers can be cleared. The refund always goes
  to the creator.
- **Non-payable calls reject coins.** Every function other than `Offer` and
  `Accept` panics if coins are sent, so nothing gets stuck in the realm.
- **Payouts are pushed** with a RealmSend banker inside the settling tx, after
  state is updated. Native coin sends run no callee code.
- **Leaderboards** (wins, net ugnot won: the opponent's stake minus the
  fee) update only on Won/Draw, so void
  or cancelled games cannot farm stats. The two top-10 boards are kept at
  settlement (`bump`), so Render never walks every player's stats.
- An `active` tree holds only Open/Playing games so the lobby render cost does
  not grow with history, and the lobby lists at most 50 of them; clients page
  through `ActiveJSON`.

## Alternatives considered

- First mover from a hash computed in `Accept` (block height, time, ids).
  Rejected: a tx can carry several messages and is atomic, so an acceptor can
  send `[Accept, Play]` and let the whole tx revert whenever the pick goes
  against them, then retry next block.
- Creator-only commit-reveal, with the `Accept` block height mixed in (the
  first hardened version). Rejected in review: a short private offer can only
  be accepted at about 12-18 heights, so a creator can grind one passphrase
  that moves first at all of them (about 2^18 tries).
- An acceptor seed sent in clear with `Accept`. Rejected: the creator sees it
  in the mempool and could cancel, or accept with another account, before
  the Accept lands whenever the draw goes against it.
- The creator picking the first mover in the offer, or a two-game match with
  each side moving first once: no randomness at all, but a different game.

- Matchmaking queue by stake tier: faster pairing, but no browsable lobby and
  it pairs people with idle players.
- Explicit "ready" handshake after accept: an extra tx per game that the first
  move already provides.
- Forfeit on first-move timeout: punishes an acceptor's opponent who simply
  posted an offer and left before it was taken; void is fairer.
- Chess-style time banks / per-game timeouts: more state and UI for little
  gain at this stage.

## Consequences

- Clocks are only as precise as block production: a move can land a few
  seconds past 90s if no block was produced in between. Symmetric for both
  players.
- A weak secret can be brute-forced offline from its public commitment,
  letting the other side steer the draw. This cannot be enforced on-chain;
  the pages ask for `openssl rand -hex 32`, and Memba generates 32 random
  bytes for both.
- Each game needs two extra txs before the first move, `Reveal` and
  `RevealSeed`, each within 90s; both players must stay online until then.
- Self-play with an alt account inflates wins but costs the fee.
- A stolen session key can still play bad moves, one per turn, in the
  owner's live games. That is inherent to signing moves without the wallet;
  the client keeps sessions short and bounded.

## Security review (before mainnet)

An audit against `docs/resources/gno-ai-contract-review.md`, the payment
guidance in `effective-gno.md` and `misc/audit-pattern-harness`, then two
reviews of this repository's PR, led to the two-sided draw, one-use
commitments, the stale-move check, session-key refusals, the fee cap,
two-step ownership, settlement-time leaderboards, the capped lobby and the
deployer-owner above. Confirmed sound:
the `IsUserCall()` + `OriginSend()` payment pair, no exported pointers or
callbacks, Render writing only validated addresses and formatted numbers,
fee < stake per game, exact refunds, and `Play` (until the deadline) and
`ClaimTimeout` (after it) never overlapping. The harness's `current_guard`
hits are the `cur.IsCurrent()` guard that AGENTS.md says not to write in
crossing functions.

## Read accessors

`GameJSON(id)` (with `seedCommitment` and `revealed`), `ActiveJSON(offset, limit)` and `LeadersJSON()` (the two top-10 boards) return hand-built JSON for
clients (Memba's Arcade) that read over `vm/qeval` instead of scraping
`Render`. Each response carries `now`, the block time, so clients count the
90s clock in chain time. The board is a 42-char column-major string. Strings
go through `strconv.Quote` although every stored string is validated on
write. The accessors never call `statsOf`, which writes on a miss.

package connect4_v4

import (
	"chain"
	"chain/banker"
	"crypto/bech32"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/p/nt/avl/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/ownable/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

const stake = int64(10_000_000)

var (
	alice   = testutils.TestAddress("alice")
	bob     = testutils.TestAddress("bob")
	carol   = testutils.TestAddress("carol")
	admin   = address("g1cvr48r7l7lkmvp77cr6zg2zhu26jgfwr0y8pew")
	pkgAddr = chain.PackageAddress("gno.land/r/samcrew/connect4")
)

func reset() {
	games, active, stats = avl.Tree{}, avl.Tree{}, avl.Tree{}
	nextID, fee, feesCollected = 0, 100_000, 0
	topWins, topGnot = nil, nil
	used, pendingOwner = avl.Tree{}, ""
	owner = ownable.NewWithAddress(admin)
	testSession = false
}

// pay sets the ugnot sent with the next call and credits the realm with it,
// mirroring what the chain does. testing.SetRealm must be called in the same
// frame that makes the cross call, so tests call it inline rather than here.
func pay(amount int64) {
	if amount == 0 {
		testing.SetOriginSend(nil)
		return
	}
	coins := chain.Coins{{"ugnot", amount}}
	testing.SetOriginSend(coins)
	testing.IssueCoins(pkgAddr, coins)
}

func balance(addr address) int64 {
	return banker.NewReadonlyBanker().GetCoin(addr, "ugnot")
}

// phrase returns a passphrase unique to the next game id.
func phrase() string { return "four random words " + strconv.Itoa(nextID+1) }

// commit returns the commitment for phrase().
func commit() string { return sha256Hex(phrase()) }

// seed returns the acceptor's seed for game id; seedCommit its commitment.
func seed(id int) string       { return "random seed " + strconv.Itoa(id) }
func seedCommit(id int) string { return sha256Hex(seed(id)) }

// accepted returns a game between alice (creator) and bob awaiting Reveal,
// and its passphrase.
func accepted(cur realm) (*Game, string) {
	p := phrase()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	pay(stake)
	id := Offer(cross(cur), "", 10, sha256Hex(p), fee)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	pay(stake)
	Accept(cross(cur), id, seedCommit(id))
	return mustGet(id), p
}

// started returns a revealed Playing game between alice (creator) and bob.
func started(cur realm) *Game {
	g, p := accepted(cur)
	revealBoth(cur, g, p)
	return g
}

// revealBoth has the creator reveal p and the acceptor its seed.
func revealBoth(cur realm, g *Game, p string) {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(g.Creator))
	pay(0)
	Reveal(cross(cur), g.ID, p)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(g.Acceptor))
	pay(0)
	RevealSeed(cross(cur), g.ID, seed(g.ID))
}

// move plays column for whoever is on turn.
func move(cur realm, g *Game, column int) {
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(g.player(g.Turn)))
	pay(0)
	Play(cross(cur), g.ID, column, g.Moves)
}

// expireClock advances block time past the 90s move clock (SkipHeights is 5s/block).
func expireClock() { testing.SkipHeights(19) }

func TestWinPaysPotMinusFee(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	g := started(cur)
	first := g.player(g.Turn)
	before := balance(first)
	for _, c := range []int{1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2, 1} { // first mover stacks column 1
		move(cur, g, c)
	}
	uassert.Equal(t, "won", g.Status.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, first, g.Winner)
	uassert.Equal(t, 2*stake-100_000, balance(first)-before)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(100_000), feesCollected)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, statsOf(first).Wins)
	uassert.Equal(t, stake-100_000, statsOf(first).GnotWon)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, statsOf(g.player(3-g.Turn)).Games)
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, active.Size())
}

func TestOfferRejects(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	pay(minStake - 1)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "stake below minimum", func() { Offer(cross(cur), "", 10, commit(), fee) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	pay(stake)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "validFor", func() { Offer(cross(cur), "", 0, commit(), fee) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	pay(stake)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "validFor", func() { Offer(cross(cur), "", 61, commit(), fee) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	pay(stake)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "yourself", func() { Offer(cross(cur), alice, 10, commit(), fee) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	pay(0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "send exactly one", func() { Offer(cross(cur), "", 10, commit(), fee) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{"ugnot", stake}, {"foo", 1}})
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "send exactly one", func() { Offer(cross(cur), "", 10, commit(), fee) })
}

func TestAcceptRejects(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	pay(stake)
	id := Offer(cross(cur), bob, 1, commit(), fee)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	pay(stake)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "own offer", func() { Accept(cross(cur), id, seedCommit(id)) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	pay(stake)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "reserved", func() { Accept(cross(cur), id, seedCommit(id)) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	pay(stake - 1)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "must send exactly", func() { Accept(cross(cur), id, seedCommit(id)) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	pay(stake + 1)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "must send exactly", func() { Accept(cross(cur), id, seedCommit(id)) })
	testing.SkipHeights(13) // 65s > 1 minute
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	pay(stake)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "expired", func() { Accept(cross(cur), id, seedCommit(id)) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(bob))
	pay(stake)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "not found", func() { Accept(cross(cur), 99, seedCommit(99)) })
}

func TestPlayRejects(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	g := started(cur)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(g.player(3 - g.Turn)))
	pay(0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "not your turn", func() { Play(cross(cur), g.ID, 1, g.Moves) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	pay(0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "not your turn", func() { Play(cross(cur), g.ID, 1, g.Moves) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(g.player(g.Turn)))
	pay(0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "column must be", func() { Play(cross(cur), g.ID, 0, g.Moves) })
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(g.player(g.Turn)))
	pay(0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "column must be", func() { Play(cross(cur), g.ID, 8, g.Moves) })
	expireClock()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(g.player(g.Turn)))
	pay(0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "clock ran out", func() { Play(cross(cur), g.ID, 1, g.Moves) })
}

func TestFullColumnRejected(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	g := started(cur)
	for i := 0; i < rows; i++ {
		move(cur, g, 4) // alternating players never make 4 in a column
	}
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(g.player(g.Turn)))
	pay(0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "column is full", func() { Play(cross(cur), g.ID, 4, g.Moves) })
}

// The creator revealed, then the first mover never moved.
func TestTimeoutBeforeFirstMoveIsVoid(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	g := started(cur)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	pay(0)
	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "has not run out", func() { ClaimTimeout(cross(cur), g.ID) })
	a, b := balance(alice), balance(bob)
	expireClock()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(carol))
	pay(0) // anyone may settle
	ClaimTimeout(cross(cur), g.ID)
	uassert.Equal(t, "void", g.Status.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, stake, balance(alice)-a)
	uassert.Equal(t, stake, balance(bob)-b)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), feesCollected)
	uassert.Equal(t, 0, stats.Size())
}

func TestTimeoutAfterMoveForfeits(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	g := started(cur)
	mover := g.player(g.Turn)
	loser := g.player(3 - g.Turn)
	move(cur, g, 1)
	expireClock()
	before := balance(mover)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(mover))
	pay(0)
	ClaimTimeout(cross(cur), g.ID)
	uassert.Equal(t, "won", g.Status.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, mover, g.Winner)
	uassert.Equal(t, 2*stake-100_000, balance(mover)-before)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(100_000), feesCollected)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, statsOf(loser).Games)
}

func TestResign(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()

	for c := 0; c < cols; c++ {
		for r := 0; r < rows; r++ {
			g.Board[c][r] = byte(1 + (c/2+r)%2)
		}
	}

	g.Moves, g.Turn = cols*rows-1, 1

	move(cur, g, 7)
	uassert.Equal(t, "draw", g.Status.String())
	uassert.Equal(t, stake, balance(alice)-a)
	uassert.Equal(t, stake, balance(bob)-b)

	reset()

// bech32m gives the other checksum of the same address, which IsValid accepts.
func bech32m(a address) address {
	_, data, err := bech32.DecodeNoLimit(a.String())
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	m, err := bech32.EncodeM("g", data)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return address(m)
}

func TestDrawUsesBothSecrets(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	// The draw is fixed by the passphrase and the seed, whenever the reveals land.
	reset()
	g, p := accepted(cur)
	testing.SkipHeights(5) // 25s, inside the reveal clocks
	revealBoth(cur, g, p)
	d := sha256.Sum256([]byte(strings.Join([]string{p, seed(g.ID), strconv.Itoa(g.ID), alice.String(), bob.String()}, "|")))
	uassert.Equal(t, 1+d[0]&1, g.Turn)
	// The creator can't fix the outcome alone: the same passphrase gives both
	// first movers depending on the acceptor's seed.
	firsts := map[byte]bool{}
	for i := 0; i < 32 && len(firsts) < 2; i++ {
		firsts[firstMover(p, "seed "+strconv.Itoa(i), g)] = true
	}
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, len(firsts))
}

	move(cur, g, 1)

	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "stale move", func() { Play(cross(cur), g.ID, 2, g.Moves+1) })
	Play(cross(cur), g.ID, 2, g.Moves)
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, g.Moves)
}

	uassert.AbortsContains(t, cur, "TransferOwnership needs", func() { TransferOwnership(cross(cur), carol) })
	// Moves stay open to sessions: that is what Quick play is for.
	move(cur, g, 1)
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, g.Moves)

	reset()

func TestBump(t *testing.T) {
	var b []leader
	for i := 0; i < 12; i++ {
		b = bump(b, testutils.TestAddress(strconv.Itoa(i)), int64(i))
	}
	uassert.Equal(t, topN, len(b))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(11), b[0].Score)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2), b[9].Score)
	b = bump(b, testutils.TestAddress("5"), 20) // already listed: moves up, not duplicated
	uassert.Equal(t, topN, len(b))
	uassert.Equal(t, testutils.TestAddress("5"), b[0].Addr)
	b = bump(b, testutils.TestAddress("late"), 11) // ties keep the earlier holder first
	uassert.Equal(t, testutils.TestAddress("11"), b[1].Addr)
	uassert.Equal(t, testutils.TestAddress("late"), b[2].Addr)
}

func TestGameJSONUnknown(t *testing.T) {

	uassert.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(GameJSON(42), `{"now":`))
}

func TestGameJSONOpenOffer(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	pay(stake)
	id := Offer(cross(cur), bob, 10, commit(), fee)
	s := GameJSON(id)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"id":1,`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"creator":"`+alice.String()+`"`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"opponent":"`+bob.String()+`"`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"acceptor":""`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"stake":10000000,`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"fee":100000,`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"status":"open"`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"turn":0,`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"turnPlayer":""`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"deadline":0,`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"board":"`+strings.Repeat("0", 42)+`"`))
}

func TestGameJSONMidPlayAndWon(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	g := started(cur)
	first := g.player(g.Turn)
	move(cur, g, 3) // first mover, column 3 -> c=2, r=0
	s := GameJSON(g.ID)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"status":"playing"`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"moves":1,`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"lastCol":2,"lastRow":0,`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"turnPlayer":"`+g.player(g.Turn).String()+`"`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"deadline":`+strconv.FormatInt(g.deadline().Unix(), 10)+`,`))
	want := strings.Repeat("0", 12) + string(rune('0'+int(3-g.Turn))) + strings.Repeat("0", 29)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"board":"`+want+`"`))
	// Second mover plays 2,2,2,4; first mover stacks column 1 four times.
	move(cur, g, 2)
	move(cur, g, 1)
	move(cur, g, 2)
	move(cur, g, 1)
	move(cur, g, 2)
	move(cur, g, 1)
	move(cur, g, 4)
	move(cur, g, 1) // first mover: column 1 rows 0-3 -> win
	s = GameJSON(g.ID)
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"status":"won"`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"winner":"`+first.String()+`"`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"turnPlayer":""`))
}

func TestActiveJSON(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
		pay(stake)
		Offer(cross(cur), "", 10, commit(), fee)
	}
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	pay(0)
	Cancel(cross(cur), 2)
	s := ActiveJSON(0, 10)
	uassert.True(t, strings.HasPrefix(s, `{"now":`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `,"fee":100000,"games":[`)) // the fee a new offer pays
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"id":1,`))
	uassert.False(t, strings.Contains(s, `"id":2,`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(s, `"id":3,`))
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, strings.Count(ActiveJSON(1, 10), `"id":`))
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, strings.Count(ActiveJSON(-5, 1), `"id":`)) // offset clamps to 0, limit 1
	uassert.Equal(t, 1, strings.Count(ActiveJSON(0, 0), `"id":`))  // limit clamps to 1
	uassert.Equal(t, 2, strings.Count(ActiveJSON(0, 1000), `"id":`))
	uassert.True(t, strings.HasSuffix(ActiveJSON(50, 10), `"games":[]}`))
}

func TestLeadersJSON(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	reset()
	uassert.Equal(t, `{"wins":[],"gnot":[]}`, LeadersJSON())
	g := started(cur)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(alice))
	pay(0)
	Resign(cross(cur), g.ID)
	uassert.Equal(t, `{"wins":[{"addr":"`+bob.String()+`","score":1}],"gnot":[{"addr":"`+bob.String()+`","score":`+strconv.FormatInt(stake-fee, 10)+`}]}`, LeadersJSON())
}
